examples.english: You are more liable to injury if you don't warm up before exercise.
examples.persian: اگر قبل از ورزش گرم نکنی، بیشتر مستعد آسیب‌دیدگی هستی.

miniContext: Liable to sth means likely to be affected by sth.

examples.english: The air traffic controllers appear intent on causing maximum disruption.
examples.persian: کنترل‌کننده‌های ترافیک هوایی مصمم به ایجاد بیشترین اختلال به‌نظر می‌رسند.

miniContext: Intent on sth means determined to do sth.

examples.english: Most flights will be subject to long delays.
examples.persian: بیشتر پروازها دچار تأخیر طولانی خواهند شد.

miniContext: Subject to sth means likely to be affected by sth, especially sth bad.

examples.english: Some of the new computers are no longer compatible with existing software.
examples.persian: برخی از رایانه‌های جدید دیگر با نرم‌افزار موجود سازگار نیستند.

miniContext: Compatible with sth means able to be used or exist with sth without causing problems.

examples.english: Technological problems are now inherent in the system.
examples.persian: مشکلات فنی اکنون جزء ذاتی این سیستم شده‌اند.

miniContext: Inherent in sth/sb means that is a basic or permanent part of sth/sb and that cannot be removed.

examples.english: Some of the workers remain resistant to change.
examples.persian: برخی از کارگران همچنان در برابر تغییر مقاومت می‌کنند.

miniContext: Resistant to sth means opposed to sth and not wanting it to happen.

examples.english: They are no longer representative of the majority.

miniContext: Representative of sth/sb means typical of a particular group or thing.

examples.english: Jasmina is dedicated to her husband.

miniContext: Dedicated to sb/sth means working hard at sth because it is very important to you.

examples.english: He is totally dependent on her.
examples.persian: او کاملاً به او وابسته است.

miniContext: Dependent on sb/sth means needing sb/sth in order to survive or be successful.

examples.english: I am very sceptical of the claim that a single vaccination could make people immune.
examples.persian: نسبت به این ادعا که یک واکسن می‌تواند مردم را ایمن کند، خیلی تردید دارم.

miniContext: Sceptical of/about sth/sb means having doubts that a claim or statement is true or that sth will happen.

examples.english: A single vaccination could make people immune to a wide range of diseases.
examples.persian: یک واکسن می‌تواند افراد را در برابر طیف وسیعی از بیماری‌ها ایمن کند.

miniContext: Immune to sth means that cannot catch or be affected by a particular illness or disease.

examples.english: Eight kilometres is roughly equivalent to five miles.
examples.persian: هشت کیلومتر تقریباً معادل پنج مایل است.

miniContext: Equivalent to sth means equal in number, amount, etc. to sth else.
